title: ÆTHER: Semma Paiyan revox (fresh take 2 music, new singer style, 64 s test)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

positive_styles: Carnatic classical music is the base: a modern Tamil dance song built on a real Carnatic kriti-style melody, with modern Western sounds layered on top, swaggering and cheeky breakup anthem, a big singalong, a completely new melody and new riff written for these words

raga Hamsadhwani (a bright five-note scale) in D: D E F# A C# only, no G, no B; the melody climbs D E F# A C# D and falls D C# A F# E D, leans on F# and C#, sung-style phrasing with gamakam: slides into notes, a wide shake on E and A, grace notes before long notes
constant tanpura drone on D and A underneath everything, modal harmony on a D pedal, almost no chord changes, the melody carries the song

adi talam, one steady 110 BPM dance groove from start to end: a real mridangam, ghatam and kanjira play the core rhythm with fast Carnatic patterns and korvai endings, a modern punchy kick, snap and deep sub bass lock to the mridangam's bass strokes
a real Carnatic violin and veena, played by real musicians, close and dry, no heavy echo, answer the voice with the raga phrases
modern Western layer on top: a plucky synth doubling the raga riff, retro brass stabs, a wide bright modern mix

a young male Tamil indie-pop singer: relaxed, smooth, conversational, half-talking cool swagger on the beat, light modern autotune sheen, every word clear, small natural slides only, no heavy ornaments
a young female indie-pop voice: soft, sweet and airy, sings the short answers and the swara lines lightly and playfully, close to the mic
konnakol rhythm syllables (tha ka dhi mi, tha ka jhanu) chanted as a hook by a gang of friends
loud, bright, punchy mix with big low end
tanpura and mridangam roll first, the female voice sings a quick swara run up the raga, then kick, sub bass and the synth riff drop together; loud from the first second

brief.notes: Jithesh 3 Nov 08:38 on fresh take 2: 'pathetic vocal, tune is fine, need fresh approach'. Keep take 2's music via conditioning (strength high, each chunk on its own slice) and replace the Carnatic-trained ornamented voices with a relaxed conversational indie-pop male voice + soft airy female voice. 64 s test (intro to first hook) before redoing the full 4 min.

story: A Chennai guy gets dumped by text on a Monday and brags he is the best guy she will ever find, dancing the hurt away with his friends. Twist: he accidentally likes her new photo.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
